ts.message: Variant model "Bug" field "sev" is stored as "type", which its base "Task" stores field "type" under. A variant's documents hold its base's fields too, so give the field another stored name.

psl.message: Fields "Task.type" and "Bug.sev" are both stored as "type", and a variant's documents hold its base's fields too. Give each field its own stored name with @map.
